# Admin console

## Requirements

- Audit logs must be tamper-evident under the Internal Controls Policy 7.
- Administrators must re-authenticate with a second factor before changing roles, per Access Policy 2.

## Stories

- As an administrator, I want to be asked for a second factor before I change a role so that a stolen session cannot grant access.
- As an administrator, I want to invite a colleague so that they can help me manage settings.
- As an administrator, I want to filter the audit log by user so that I can investigate an incident.
- As an administrator, I want to export the audit log to a spreadsheet so that I can share it with the auditor.
